root_causes.description: A serving API pod has rendered configuration inconsistent with the desired release.
Retries for one logical payment do not preserve the correct business idempotency identity.
A consumer revision is incompatible with the currently emitted event contract.
Mixed invalidator revisions leave stale cache entries.
Insufficient request-processing capacity causes the incident.
Database connection starvation causes the observed failures.
Network/DNS instability explains the user-visible failures.

actions.description: Replace only a pod proven to have rendered-config drift.
Reuse one stable provider idempotency key for the same logical order version across retries.
